followUps.title: Catalog page and CatalogSearch each fetch the same facets
followUps.reason: Every catalog page load sends two identical facets requests; passing the result from the page to CatalogSearch would remove one.

followUps.title: Fix existing dotnet format findings in Catalog.API and WebAppComponents
followUps.reason: Missing UTF-8 BOM and whitespace at CatalogApi.cs lines 91 and 98 make --verify-no-changes fail on any change to these files.

followUps.title: Fix dotnet format (whitespace/charset) violations across the codebase on main
followUps.reason: CatalogApi.cs and the CatalogFacets records failed --verify-no-changes on origin/main, so any story touching other such files will hit the same check.

followUps.title: Fix existing dotnet format whitespace, final-newline and charset violations across the solution
followUps.reason: Solution-wide `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` fails on about 140 existing issues in Catalog.API, Identity.API, Ordering.*, ServiceDefaults, EventBusRabbitMQ, Webhooks.API, AppHost and the test projects, so a repo-wide format gate can never pass for any story until a separate cleanup ticket fixes them.
